notes.title: VRLegs Update 0.5.20241120 - The Gadget Update

Hey Runners! We've got some cool new items for you to play with!

notes.title: New update - 0.3.1.240515.b
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Runners![/h2]

Today we are coming to you with a [b]New Update[/b] 0.3.1.240515.b! Hope you will enjoy the new changes! 

Lets jump into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/501aa63289fcbd17d146614096df77f44f6d2c4e.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]

1. Item and Energy System:

[list]
[*] Players can now generate and use items, or provide them for others. Creating items will consume energy, which players can collect from energy fragments that appear randomly in the game during parkour activities.
[/list]

2. [b]New Items Added:[/b]

[list]
[*] Bomb: Throw it to create an explosion after a delay, launching nearby objects into the air.
[*] Checkpoint Flag: Place it anywhere; if you hit a Dead Zone, you'll respawn at the flag's location.
[*] Firework: Launch a firework from your hand to pull yourself a short distance.
[*] Paraglider: Glide long distances from high places, controlling your flight speed and direction with your hands.
[*] Peek Lens: A transparent lens to see other players and keys through objects.
[*] Sonic Horn: Emits sound waves that push away nearby objects.
[*] Teleport Ball: Throw it and teleport to where it lands, if it’s not intercepted.
[*] Teleport Talkies: Comes in pairs. Share with another player for long-distance communication and teleportation to each other's location.
[/list]

3. [b]Shop System:[/b]

[list]
[*] A new shop system is now available for purchasing items.
[/list]

4. [b]Tasks for Tokens:[/b]

[list]
[*] Complete tasks to earn tokens used in the shop.
[/list]

[b]5. Notification System:[/b]

[list]
[*] Stay updated with in-game notifications about important events and updates.
[/list]

[h3][b]Content Optimizations:[/b]
[/h3]

[list]
[*] Disabled lip sync for speaking to improve performance.
[*] Enabled real-time shadows and enhanced rendering resolution on Quest 3.
[*] Improved the throwing experience.
[*] Adjusted gameplay boundaries: Players moving outside a specified area will immediately become the Tagger.
[*] New players joining mid-game will start as the Tagger.
[*] Added imperial units for displaying height.
[*] Introduced a Weekly Leaderboard.
[*] Implemented a user reporting system to manage community rule violations.
[*] Display boards for community rules are now available within the game scenes.
[*] Players can now adjust the game's maximum movement speed.
[*] Added an option for auto-forward running and to disable the right joystick jump.
[*] Moderators can now access an in-game moderator interface.
[/list]


[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where a light press on the grab key caused incorrect gestures.
[*] Fixed a bug in the PC version's culling related to camera activation disrupting the main view.
[*] Addressed the issue where wall jumps were too low when falling at high speeds.
[/list]

Thank you for the time and support you are giving us!

Have a great day!

[i][b]~VR Legs Team[/b][/i]
